subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and if so should it be a config key, a default-on CLI change, or no new surface?
rationale: The requested behavior is useful and still missing, but OpenClaw policy treats new config/default surfaces as high-bar product decisions and prior PRs tried incompatible shapes.

options.title: Add a narrow config default
options.body: Approve one canonical key such as `tui.deliver` or a maintainer-chosen equivalent, with types, strict schema, help labels, docs, and CLI override tests.

options.title: Flip the CLI default instead
options.body: Make TUI delivery default-on with an explicit opt-out flag, accepting the broader behavior change instead of adding config surface.

options.title: Keep explicit flag only
options.body: Decline new config/default behavior, keep `--deliver` and shell aliases as the supported path, and close this issue with rationale.

recommendation.title: Add a narrow config default
recommendation.body: Approve one canonical key such as `tui.deliver` or a maintainer-chosen equivalent, with types, strict schema, help labels, docs, and CLI override tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the TUI surface and is the clearest product-routing owner from the available current-main history.
